<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="430" height="932" viewBox="0 0 430 932">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="430" height="932" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y="31" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <rect x="357" y="20" width="3" height="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="363" y="18" width="3" height="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="369" y="15" width="3" height="11" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="388" cy="22" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="388" y1="22" x2="394" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="402" y="16" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="423" y="19" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="404" y="18" width="15" height="7" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Brand and introduction -->
  <text x="32" y="92" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="28.92px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">make</text>
  <text x="32" y="143" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="25.83px" font-weight="300" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan x="32" dy="0">Create your account</tspan>
    <tspan x="32" dy="29" font-size="14px" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Join a community made for your beauty routine.</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Login / signup tabs -->
  <text x="32" y="220" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan x="32">Log in</tspan>
    <tspan x="160" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign up</tspan>
  </text>
  <line x1="158" y1="232" x2="224" y2="232" stroke="#965128" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="32" y1="244" x2="398" y2="244" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Form labels and fields -->
  <text x="32" y="274" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan x="32" dy="0">Email or username</tspan>
    <tspan x="32" dy="78">Create password</tspan>
    <tspan x="32" dy="78">Confirm password</tspan>
  </text>

  <rect x="32" y="286" width="366" height="52" rx="40" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <text x="54" y="318" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Big Shoulders Display, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="300" fill="#1C1C1E">you@example.com</text>
  <circle cx="371" cy="312" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="365" y1="312" x2="377" y2="312" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <rect x="32" y="364" width="366" height="52" rx="40" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <text x="54" y="396" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Big Shoulders Display, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="300" fill="#1C1C1E">At least 8 characters</text>
  <circle cx="371" cy="390" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="367" y1="390" x2="375" y2="390" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <rect x="32" y="442" width="366" height="52" rx="40" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <text x="54" y="474" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Big Shoulders Display, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="300" fill="#1C1C1E">Repeat your password</text>
  <circle cx="371" cy="468" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="367" y1="468" x2="375" y2="468" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <text x="32" y="519" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Big Shoulders Display, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="300" fill="#FFFFFFCC">
    <tspan x="32">Use 8+ characters with a number or symbol.</tspan>
    <tspan x="32" dy="24">By continuing, you agree to our community guidelines.</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Primary and secondary actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="570" width="366" height="52" rx="40" fill="#965128" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="215" y="603" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="20px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign up</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="638" width="366" height="52" rx="40" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="215" y="671" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Log in instead</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Social sign-in area -->
  <line x1="32" y1="724" x2="144" y2="724" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="286" y1="724" x2="398" y2="724" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="215" y="729" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFFCC">or continue with</text>

  <g>
    <circle cx="142" cy="773" r="25" fill="#1C1C1E" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M142 758 C134 758 130 765 130 773 C130 782 136 788 142 788 C148 788 154 782 154 773 C154 765 150 758 142 758 Z" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M138 756 C139 752 143 751 146 754 C145 758 141 760 138 756 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="215" cy="773" r="25" fill="#1C1C1E" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M226 773 C226 766 221 762 215 762 C209 762 204 767 204 773 C204 779 209 784 215 784 C220 784 224 781 226 777 L215 777 L215 773 Z" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="288" cy="773" r="25" fill="#1C1C1E" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M281 765 L295 765 L295 779 L281 779 Z" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M282 766 L288 772 L294 766" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="20" y="835" width="390" height="72" rx="40" fill="#1C1C1E" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
    <polygon points="62,859 73,850 84,859 84,872 62,872" fill="none"/>
    <polyline points="64,859 73,852 82,859"/>
    <circle cx="151" cy="858" r="8"/>
    <line x1="157" y1="864" x2="163" y2="870"/>
    <circle cx="238" cy="854" r="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="238" cy="869" rx="11" ry="6"/>
    <line x1="318" y1="852" x2="338" y2="852"/>
    <line x1="318" y1="861" x2="338" y2="861"/>
    <line x1="318" y1="870" x2="338" y2="870"/>
  </g>
  <text x="215" y="893" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan x="73">Home</tspan>
    <tspan x="151">Discover</tspan>
    <tspan x="238">Profile</tspan>
    <tspan x="328">More</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="160" y="918" width="110" height="5" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
